dedupe_keys.name: date locale registrul de drumuri de interes local si judetean

description: Date locale- Registrul de Drumuri de Interes Local și Județean is a dataset listed in data.gov.ro, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministerul Dezvoltării, Lucrărilor Publice și Administrației. Local data platform of the Ministry of Development, Public Works and Administration. A tool that brings together two important components of urban development: Register of Urban Planning and Register of Roads of Local and County Interest. Coverage: Ministerul Dezvoltării, Lucrărilor Publice și Administrației. The portal shows the English title as "Local data - Register of Roads of Local and County Interest" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ministerul Dezvoltării, Lucrărilor Publice și Administrației. Its keywords include date locale. The listing shows 2026-06-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ro.
